pgo.scope:
Inspect selected PGO acceptance in the two imported production Base libraries.

This is a bounded read-only code-generation check, not training or a throughput
result. At most two archive members per arm are disassembled. Current profile
keys and genuine optimized entry metadata are required; historical entry counts
are not acceptance thresholds because optimization can adjust those counts.

protocol.ratio_definition: Median of within-pair candidate/reference durations. It need not equal the ratio of separately reported marginal medians.

qualifications: The eleven mixed-property lanes were in the original thirteen-launch PGO workload. Other companion lanes here were held out; all execution directs profile output to /dev/null.
Intervals are per-lane observations from this single CPU6 cohort, with no multiplicity adjustment. Small slower intervals are retained as flags, not asserted universal causal regressions.
Shared-host activity and bimodal durations are preserved in raw rows/host records. Other team compiler/inspection activity was paused during timing; global host idleness is not claimed.
This report does not measure the shipping executable, construction, paint, or startup. The separately published shipping readiness cohort remains a separate result.
Successful public API tests, native loader proof and selected PGO acceptance are bounded checks, not universal behavioral equivalence.
No exact symbolized companion twin was captured. Shipping symbol twins cannot be silently treated as the measured QA code.
Original build/source/graph/host/tool/profile manifests and raw producers are preserved in the text appendix. Binary/profile contents remain separate authenticated artifacts.
